# Ludlow municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Selectboard is Brett Sanderson (Chair), George Tucker Jr., Justin Hyjek, Scott Baitz, and Noah Schmidt

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 125 (Town of Ludlow): section 2: the Selectboard's powers are exercised by ballot as provided; the town's charter carries no officer list, so town offices follow general law. The SOS selectboard directory publishes no Ludlow roster ('Contact the Town Clerk'); the town's own officers documents for two cycles and the VT Jurisdiction Factory concord on the five

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): Ulla P. Cook is Town Clerk (recorded Ulla Cook)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Ulla Cook as Ludlow's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Ulla Cook as Ludlow's town clerk contact

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): Ulla P. Cook is Town Treasurer, term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Ulla Cook as Ludlow's treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists no Ludlow treasurer; the town's officers document and the Guide concur on Ulla Cook

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Moderator line seats Newton Rose with a term expiring in 2025; no later town document publishes the office's outcome, so the post is created without a membership. Rose is certified elected Moderator of Ludlow Village in 2026; his person record is created by the village build

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the First Constable line seats Jeffrey Billings (elected) with a term expiring in 2025; no later town document publishes the outcome, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Delinquent Tax Collector is the Municipal Manager, Brendan McNamara, holding the office by appointment (both officers documents)

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Listers line reads: 'None (elected) March 2024 / Douglas Sheehan (appointed) 2025 / Jeanne Stasz (elected) 2027'. Only Jeanne Stasz is minted; Sheehan's appointed term has expired and the third seat is unfilled by election

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Cemetery Trustees line carries five seats on five-year terms: Bruce Schmidt, Chair (to 2029), and Shannon Stark (2028) hold current elected terms; Robert Brandt's term expired in 2025, Ludwig Gabranski's in 2026, and Scott Baitz's appointed term in 2025, and no official source publishes those outcomes, so those seats are unfilled

Town of Ludlow, 'Appointed and Elected Officers' document (the town's official FY25 officers sheet, the post-March 2024 state; the FY24 sheet concurs on the office set): the Trustees of Public Funds line reads 'None (elected)'; Ulla Cook's elected term expired in 2025 and Douglas Sheehan's appointed term expired in 2025, so the post is created without a membership

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names ten justices of the peace for Ludlow: Laura Creaser, Theresa Gurdak-Carter, Joe Josselyn, John Merrow, Alice Nitka, Judy Pullinen, Virginia Snyder, Jean Strong, John Murphy, and Joyce Washburn. The town officers document's JP block is the prior (November 2022) slate and does not govern
